blurb: Emporium Arcade Bar offers a combination of classic arcade games, pinball machines, and a full bar with craft beers and cocktails. They host live shows, DJs, game tournaments, and events regularly. Guests can book group outings, bring outside food, and enjoy a lively entertainment venue.
